population: PSF morphology, maskbits=0; native photometry and all original held-out sky blocks/cones retained

prior.policy: Retain the original completeness constant and footprint convention, select PSF counts after restoring the original draw, flag bands below the previous 2000-object calibration threshold. Fewer than 20 population measurements gives evidence only.

outlier.policy: Retain the selected Student-t degrees of freedom and scale factor; refit field moments and eta on PSF sources unused for fitting component shapes.

spatial.policy_origin: same explicit settings as the validated Legacy PSF spatial restoration; new 41-band validation is separate
